thread:
Sam: Vendor ShadowRoot confirmed pentest window 2025-12-08 -> 2025-12-10. Need owners for ephemeral RBAC, KMS alias, audit snapshot, evidence manifest format, and retest policy. Thoughts?

Irene: I'll own RBAC. staging + preprod only, TTL 6h, permission boundary to pen-test-ingest prefix. No prod. I'll open a PR today.

Noah: I'll take audit/KMS. Use alias/shadowroot-evidence. No cross-account grants; prefer presigned uploads of vendor-side encrypted blobs. I'll create snapshot bucket s3://redwood-audit/shadowroot/ and schedule exports at t0 and t_end.

Sam: Can we reserve retest slots? Propose 2025-12-22 and 2026-01-05 as tentative. Noah, please add manifest template; require sha256 and uploader contact.

Noah: Manifest template (will be in runbook): {"uploader":"ShadowRoot","object_key":"pen-test-ingest/20251208/session-1.enc","kms_key_alias":"alias/shadowroot-evidence","uploaded_at":"2025-12-08T13:00:00Z","sha256":"sha256:...","uploader_contact":"assessor@shadowroot.test"}

audit-bot: PR #1203 created (iam/ephemeral-shadowroot + bucket policy). CI: checks passed :white_check_mark:

security-oncall: Escalation rule: if vendor reports a confirmed exploitable SEV1 during the window, open #incident-pt-shadowroot, page oncall, and attach remediation board link. Target ack <= 15m.

Irene: PR will require MFA in trust policy and restrict principal to vendor AWS account. Role policies limited to s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on pen-test-ingest/* and kms:Decrypt scoped to alias/shadowroot-evidence. Permission boundary denies access outside the ingest prefix.

Sam: Legal: need signed DPA/NDA with explicit KMS constraint and retention terms (proposed 90d). @Legal can you fast-track?

Noah: Upload workflow: presigned PUTs to avoid sharing keys; vendor encrypts client-side. If decrypt help is required, create a short-lived role that allows kms:Decrypt for the alias — do not create KMS grants.

Irene: TTL enforcement via lambda that revokes sessions after 6h and logs revocations to CloudWatch. I'll add an audit event to the export.

ci-bot: scheduled job created -> ephemeral-ttl-rotator (every 3h).

Sam: Operational rule reminder: absolutely NO SSH or direct host access. Provide session recordings or jumpbox replays only.

Noah: I'll add an index.json in pen-test-ingest/YYYYMMDD/ listing manifests and checksums for chain-of-custody. Runbook will include a small verifier script and Athena queries for STS:AssumeRole spikes.

Sam: Thanks — once PR + runbook + NDA are green I'll do the vendor handshake and post the assessor onboarding doc. Target to close blockers by EOD tomorrow.
